cells.gaps: The 37,389 Sudanese refugees of June 2026 are registered with a number, but no source says identity documents were issued to them. No source since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID.
cells.note: Stage 2: UNHCR and the CNR had registered 37,389 Sudanese refugees by June 2026, and registration of new arrivals goes on. No source says documents were issued to them, so question 2 is unmet.
